status: Selected Tower route implemented and verified in the recorded Chromium/Metal scope.

implementation.behavior: Eight real bells, protected service bays, continuous spiral stair geometry, open mouths and landings, clear overhead collision, actual church lighting and calibrated handlamp. Ordinary movement traverses both stairs and reaches the crossing.
Three safe optional apparatus interactions teach HOLD, MONITOR and EXPOSE; wrong answers cost nothing, leaving is permitted, completion is saved, and learned machinery visibly settles.

Two legible Cathedral phases use the recorder, torch and optional rig. Correct counters prevent their blow. Real movement progress damages the bell frame, drops a bell, splits the pulpitum and extinguishes the lantern. Retries preserve the cleared phase; the third defeat causes the terminal ending.

An actual regrippable body follows the player through the nave and west doors. There is no timed-reset gauntlet. Saves preserve player/body trail, grip and camera. The player must clear the authored leaf by0.25m and the prone body centre by1.1m, covering its entire rotated shipped footprint. A three-metre apron permits continuous grip before the yard seam.

Rescue is earned by moving both bodies outside. Loss is caused by the third defeat and uses eight real strikes and progressive body control. Resistance expresses agency without gating completion. Both have a unique held world image, epilogue, credits and persisted return. Reloading an already-earned rescue retains its completed spatial score. Terminal shots reserve their actor light, detach the gameplay torch, suppress unrelated apparitions, and retain correct foreground material boundaries. The prone torso now lies entirely above its authored floor.
When earned in the personal walk, the actual retained 14 second PCM receives its coda; confirmation cannot cut it short, pause preserves its offset, and credits clean it up.
